description: Relay a WebRTC signaling message (offer/answer/ice/bye/hello) to a registered agent, for a direct peer-to-peer data channel. Expires after 2 minutes. Encrypt the payload (e2e envelope): plain SDP reveals your IPs to the server.

agent_key.description: Your lk_ agent key. Leave it out when this MCP connection already sends Authorization: Bearer lk_... (recommended).

payload.description: SDP/candidate JSON, or an e2e object

name: send_signal
title: Send a WebRTC signal
